prompt: A towering curling wave of churning cerulean and white seawater crashes from the left across a muddy medieval battlefield at dusk, sweeping armored soldiers and a horned beast off their feet, their bodies tumbling helplessly in the foaming surge, swords and a shield flung into the air. Worm-eye low angle so the wave-crest looms over the viewer. The background is a dim violet stormy sky above a flooded field.

A massive cresting tidal wave of deep sapphire and foaming white water curls over a battlefield, three small dark soldier silhouettes caught mid-tumble inside the translucent face of the wave, weapons and helmets scattering through the spray. Side-on profile of the wave filling the upper two-thirds of the frame. The background is a moonlit teal horizon and a wet sand shore strewn with abandoned shields.

A drained, glistening battlefield at dawn as a flood recedes rapidly toward the horizon, dragging two struggling armored figures and a riderless warhorse away into the rushing cyan water, their arms reaching back toward the empty muddy field. Wet ground in the foreground littered with a dropped sword and a tangled banner. The background is a pale grey-blue misty sky over a distant waterline.

Close-up of a single armored knight being engulfed and lifted off his feet by a surging wall of foaming turquoise water, his body twisted sideways mid-tumble, shield torn from his arm and spinning away in the spray, mouth agape. The churning water fills most of the frame. The background is a dark stormy slate-blue sky.

A diagonal flood surge of glowing cerulean and white water rushes from the upper right down across a stone-paved courtyard, sweeping away a goblin, a robed soldier, and a large beast, their limbs flailing as they are carried in the current, dropped weapons swirling in the foam. High three-quarter aerial view looking down at the deluge. The background is wet flagstones and a half-submerged broken statue.

A blue-robed water mage stands on a rocky outcrop facing right, both arms thrown forward, conjuring a colossal curling wave of sapphire seawater that crashes down on a field of small soldiers and beasts below, scattering them into the foam. The mage is a small dark silhouette at frame left; the wave dominates the right. The background is a bruised purple twilight sky over a flooded plain.

A surging wall of foaming white and cyan floodwater bursts through a stone village gate at night, violently sweeping a horned ogre, two soldiers, and a wolf off their feet and tumbling backward toward the viewer, their weapons flung loose in the churning spray. Low frontal angle, the wave rushing toward the camera. The only light is a cold blue moonlit glow on the foam. The background is dark drowned cottages.

Several armored soldiers and a large green scaled beast are seen from behind, small and dark in the lower foreground, as a colossal curling cerulean tidal wave looms over them about to break and sweep them all away, foam exploding off its crest. The creatures brace and stagger. Wide cinematic shot, wave filling the upper frame. The background is an overcast steel-grey sky meeting the sea.

A glowing turquoise flood pours across a sunlit grassy battlefield, lifting and carrying away a tumbling knight, a robed mage, and a fleeing boar in its bright current, helmets and a torn banner spinning in the foam. Bright daytime palette, clear teal water against green grass. Three-quarter side view of the surge moving left to right. The background is a sunny pale-blue sky over distant hills.
